title: Keyboard Manager. Remap a shortcut does not work with certain key combinations

status.label: Reporter confirmed the setting resolves the concern
status.detail: After a maintainer suggested using the Paste As Plain Text settings page, the author said this should work and that remapping Ctrl+V to another shortcut was a bad idea. No remaining defect is described.

judgment.rationale: The author replied to the maintainer’s suggestion that Paste As Plain Text be configured in its own settings page, said they believed this would work, and acknowledged that remapping Ctrl+V would cause other problems. The thread contains no later report that the settings solution failed. This is a resolved expectation/configuration issue rather than an actionable Keyboard Manager defect.
evidence: The author initially mapped Ctrl+V to Win+Ctrl+Alt+V and noted that invoking the Paste As Plain Text shortcut directly worked.
A contributor suggested configuring the shortcut in the Paste As Plain Text settings page.
The author replied that this should work and said remapping Ctrl+V was a bad idea because it could break other paste types.
The issue remains open with Needs-Team-Response, but there is no assignee and no later report of failure.
judgment.recommended_action: No code change or duplicate request is warranted; the author acknowledged the settings-based solution.

fix_assessment.rationale: The author accepted the product’s Paste As Plain Text shortcut setting and withdrew the proposed Ctrl+V remap after recognizing its side effects; no unresolved PowerToys code behavior remains.

issue_context.summary: The author initially remapped Ctrl+V to the Paste As Plain Text shortcut, then accepted using the dedicated Paste As Plain Text setting instead.
known_information: The report lists PowerToys 0.79.0 and says invoking the Paste As Plain Text shortcut manually works.
The contributor suggested configuring the shortcut in the Paste As Plain Text settings page.
The author replied that the setting should resolve the concern and acknowledged the remap could interfere with other paste types.
inferences: The issue is resolved for the author through the dedicated settings path, although the issue itself remains open.
issue_context.analysis: The author’s response closes the key diagnostic loop: the feature itself works, and the author accepted the intended settings surface instead of overriding Ctrl+V globally. No new request or code fix is supported.
initial_investigation: Read the full issue body and both comments, including the author’s explicit acknowledgment of the setting-based solution.
Confirmed no later comments, assignee, or unresolved failure report.
